reviews.title: Ruined by SI journalism
reviews.text: This otherwise amazing app is eclipsed by a horrendous partnership with Sports Illustrated AI generated clickbait journalism. It’s a shame Fotmob won’t dedicate itself to something better. Even a tabloid has better banter than the soulless SI junk it’s forcing down your throat. I’ve paid for the app for multiple years and this is quickly driving me away.

reviews.title: Once upon a time, it was a great app
reviews.text: Fotmob ended what made it superior to similar apps. Fotmob’s live commentary section was excellent when it provided timely, factual, and pertinent match details. The addition of polls, emojis, and opinions ruined the live commentary. Those social media lite aspects are intrusive and annoying. The actual commentary has seemingly become superflous and exists only a tool for emojis and interaction. The bold font and larger line spacing used for the polls  interrupts the commentary and further relegates the commentary text to a triviality. Even worse is the inclusion of opinions in the live commentary. What a massive downgrade and disappointment. Fotmob ruined what set it apart from the rest. Fotmob seems to want to be an app for serious football fans as well as a social media app, and in trying to be both, it excels as neither. It’s no longer special or unique - just another app in a crowded category.
